messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the California cohort space. ICF staff set this up so we can coordinate our plant visits and share make-day calendars locally.

messages.author: renata.palacios.102026@norgaardfarmstead.example
messages.text: Thanks Thibault. I am glad we have a dedicated place to compare notes on spring milk yields and acidification rates across Sonoma and Marin.

messages.author: david.draper.101160@quillpost.example
messages.text: Demand at the counter is strong this season, but finding enough transport for our aged wheels is getting complicated.

messages.author: brian.ashworth.101900@postfield.example
messages.text: We are running out of cave space in Petaluma sooner than expected. I might need to ask Ayumi for advice on humidity control.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: The upcoming conference schedule is out, and several of us need to present our make-day notes from last fall.

messages.author: mary.grantham.101213@kestrelmoorcreamery.example
messages.text: Production is at peak capacity here, so Sakura and I are looking into adjusting our vat rotation to keep up.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Given the rising supply costs everyone is dealing with, ICF staff has added hardship dues info for members who need it.

messages.author: renata.palacios.102026@norgaardfarmstead.example
messages.text: The new raw-milk aging guidelines are finally making sense for our batch tracking, which saves us a lot of paperwork.

messages.author: grace.pace.102211@novacekscheeseshop.example
messages.text: Traceability audits went smoothly this month. It helps that we standardized our make logs across the Sonoma vats last year.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: We should schedule one final in-person tasting before the end of the year to review how the consolidation talks went.
